title: store unfinished list
description: What <app> store unfinished list answers with -o json: the changes cut short in the app's store scope, every user's whose mark is there and this user's journals whose marks are gone, so a person sees what holds a thing back and who must run again before clearing a mark (ADR-S22, G-STACK-13).

kind.description: Always StoreUnfinishedList, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

data.description: The changes cut short in the scope, or in the one thing asked for.

changes.description: Each change cut short: first those whose marks are there, then this user's left journals. Empty when none is, so a reader tells nothing left from a failure.
